<!--
  _partials/_setup.qmd — loaded at the top of every interactive page.
  It imports the simulation engine (js/popgen/) once, so every page uses the
  same code. If you add a new exported function to js/popgen/ and want to use
  it on a page, add its name to the list below.
  Files starting with "_" are not rendered as pages by Quarto.
-->

```{ojs}
//| include: false
import {
  simulate, simulateReplicates, simulateScenarios, DEFAULT_PARAMS,
  genotypeFreqs, alleleFreqFromGenotypes, fitnessFromSH, meanFitness,
  mutationEquilibrium, mutationSelectionBalance, expectedHeterozygosity,
  heterozygosity, hweChiSquare,
  mean, sd, finalRows, summarizeFinal, meanByGeneration, genotypesLong,
  alleleTrajectoryPlot, genotypePlot, hardyWeinbergCurves,
  finalFrequencyHistogram, heterozygosityPlot,
  GENOTYPE_COLORS, SCENARIO_COLORS, COLORS
} from "/js/popgen/index.js"
```
